services.name: Sailing Trip
services.desc: “Caper Too” is a Marshall Sandpiper, a traditional 15′ gaff-rigged catboat. Catboats were commonly used by fisherman across Cape Cod’s waters before power boats took over. Catboats are known for their versatility in shallow water as they need only a foot or so of water to sail over the shallows. Don’t be fooled. This 15′ sailboat has the feel of boats almost twice their length. “Caper Too’s” ample cockpit and molded bench-seats ensure a a smooth sailing experience. But bring your foul weather jacket, as a bit of salt spray is often part of the sailing experience.
